title: Reporting period is established from the workbook
objective: A whole month cannot be posted against the wrong period.
method: Period read from summary headings, cross-checked to the Rates date and file name; all three must agree.

title: Entity tab column and row resolution
objective: No balance read from the wrong column; no subtotal double-counted.
method: Columns resolved against a per-entity layout registry; fallbacks and skipped rows listed.

title: Account continuity across periods
objective: An account missing from an extract is not read as a nil balance.
method: Accounts present in an earlier period are checked for presence in the latest period; disappearances listed.

title: Account key uniqueness
objective: Each account carries a stable, unique key within an entity-period.
method: Codes tested for uniqueness within an entity-period; duplicates listed. Renames/re-codes confirmed manually.

title: Entity trial balance foots in functional currency
objective: Each entity TB sums to nil in its own functional currency before anything is derived.
method: Debit-positive sum of every account per entity-period; a non-nil result is raised before mapping.
tolerance: Nil; rounding up to 2 units reported not escalated

title: Seeds tie to the pack at account level
objective: The seeds hold exactly what the pack holds, at account level, not merely in total.
method: Cumulative bronze movements compared to the pack closing balance per account for every entity-period.

title: Year-to-date to monthly movement, with year reset
objective: YTD-to-movement is correct within a year and resets at the year boundary.
method: Movement = new YTD less cumulative held; must reset at the financial-year start.

title: Accrual overlay reproduces the client figure and nets to nil
objective: The decomposition into ledger balance and adjustment cannot move a reported number.
method: Overlay = netted less plain amount (invariant, script); overlay nets to nil within an entity-period (SQL).

title: Accrual / netted column identification
objective: An entity-month is not silently read pre-accrual.
method: Header vocabulary matched to an alias list; unheaded netted column located positionally and raised.

title: Computed tax agrees with the client rate
objective: Where an entity carries no tax account, the modelled charge matches the client rate and does not double-count.
method: Rate taken from the client formula, held per entity-period; charge tops up to the client figure.

title: Elimination journals balance
objective: Every elimination is a balanced double entry, applied once.
method: Debits equal credits within each journal id, tested on every build.

title: Budget ties: subsidiary rolls up to group
objective: The budget agrees to approval, is on a cumulative basis, and subsidiary rolls up to group exactly.
method: Income lines: sum of subsidiary budget equals the group budget line per period.

title: Bad-debt provision ties to the debtor analysis
objective: The provision agrees to the debtor analysis and to the management report.
method: Provision rows summed to the reported figure; revenue shown net.

title: Below-the-line P&L adjustments authorised
objective: Manual P&L entries are submitted, authorised and visible as adjustments.
method: Each adjustment held with period, line, scope, type, amount; shown below PBT.
tolerance: Each authorised in writing before load

title: Cutover accrual reclassifications governed
objective: Workbook accrual reclassifications survive the BC move as a governed adjustment.
method: Held in a seed reconciling to nil per entity; parallel run at cutover must match.

title: Revenue-stream allocation ties to pooled revenue
objective: The product/BU split is provided by Finance and reconciles to the pooled account.
method: Allocated streams must sum to the entity pooled revenue for the period.
tolerance: Allocation sums to the pool exactly

title: Uganda equity pickup excluded from the union
objective: The equity-accounted associate never enters the TB union.
method: Uganda excluded from the main union by construction; the exclusion is asserted.

title: FX rates present, dated and typed
objective: Closing and average rates held separately, dated to the period, applied per policy.
method: Every non-KES entity currency has a CLOSING and AVERAGE rate for each period.
tolerance: Rate row dated to the period end

title: Client workbook rate references correct
objective: Rate references inside the client pack point at the reported period and correct type.
method: Every Rates reference resolved and compared to the period and statement it serves.

title: Every account with a balance reaches a statement line
objective: No value is silently dropped between the trial balance and the published statements.
method: Accounts carrying a balance with no statement-line mapping are listed and quantified.

title: Account mapping is effective-dated without overlaps
objective: A mid-year mapping change is dated, not retrospective, and a balance is not counted twice.
method: Each mapping row carries a span; spans for one account must not intersect.

title: KES TB foots beyond the translation plug
objective: After translation the TB foots beyond IAS 21, and the plug does not hide unmapped balance.
method: Translation difference modelled as the residual; the unmapped portion carried and tested separately.
tolerance: Nil beyond translation; unmapped within KES 1

title: Trial balance mart ties to the subsidiary statements
objective: The account-grain TB and the statement reports are the same population.
method: Excluding unmapped accounts, the TB mart agrees to the subsidiary SCI and SFP per entity-period.

title: Statements tie to the client SCI and SFP Detailed
objective: Each reported line cell agrees to the client statement, every difference attributed.
method: Every line cell compared and bucketed; client-side defects separated from our own.

title: Report-line map derived from the account map
objective: The management taxonomy is derived from the confirmed mapping and cannot drift.
method: Every report-line row must have a live account-map row; every P&L account must reach a report line.

title: Certification and release gate
objective: Nothing is released until every control is passing or its variance is explained and accepted.
method: Release authorised only when blocks A-C pass or are dispositioned and Finance signs off.
tolerance: No critical exception open without a dated plan
